description: This file defines the ProductRepository interface, extending JpaRepository, for CRUD operations related to Product entities in a Spring Data JPA context. It includes custom query methods to find products by SKU and filter active products ordered by name.

classes.name: ProductRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Product entity, providing data access methods.

methods.name: findBySku
methods.description: Finds a product by its SKU, returning an Optional Product.

methods.name: findByActiveTrueOrderByNameAsc
methods.description: Retrieves a list of active products ordered ascendingly by their name.
